response.overview: Spencer, an adventurous boy who is obsessed with cartoons especially his favorite show and comic book series “Hopping Around.” His dream is to become part of their stories, and soon enough, his dream comes true. A wild near-sighted rabbit and an adventurous caterpillar soon meet Spencer during one of their comic book stories – only to realize Spencer may not have what it takes to be a true cartoon character after all. Spencer’s little autistic brother (Joey) who idolizes his big brother, is now tasked with rescuing his big brother from staying locked up in a cartoon series. A feature film of half animation and half live action.
response.title: Come Home
